verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official documented MCP server that works with any MCP client tool (Antigravity, Claude Code/Desktop, Cline, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Windsurf, etc.), enabling agents to manage Firebase projects, Auth, Firestore, and more. This is corroborated by both docs and a dedicated probe confirming the official page. Missing for 10: independent hands-on community report validating the MCP server's real-world reliability.
